verdict.rationale: A robotics simulation and learning platform could plausibly offer in-product AI analysis of simulation or sensor data, so this axis applies. The evidence covers synthetic data generation, policy training, and robot foundation models, none of which is AI-generated insights or suggestions surfaced to the user from their own data. The AI agent skill for upgrading ROS 2 nodes is a code-migration aid, an adjacent feature that earns no credit here.
